attBesluta.text: Just what I expected, works great
I was very satisfied with the quality of the hitch. I use it to pull a 35 foot trailer with 9000 lbs axles hauling tractors.
Satisfait du crochet, il répond à mes attentes pour mon usage.
Works great toeing the tote or honey pot to the dump station. I don't worry about the possibility of the honey pot getting away from my yow vehicle. A normal ball did have the honey pot come off.

this cart is actually really well built and rolls incredibly easy, I've used it around my mechanic shop a few weeks now and you honestly cant beat it for the price. a lot easier than taking my tool box around.
